responsibility: This definition module exposes the generated parser entry point for mc pass 4. The compilation driver invokes its CompilationUnit routine to perform the constant-expression pass that augments previously built declarations with compile-time expression trees and associated semantic information.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for pass 4, declaring only the exported CompilationUnit entry point. Unlike mcp4.bnf, it does not contain the generated grammar rules or semantic-action implementation.
